content.text: {"answer":"Not less than seven years from the end of the fiscal year during which the last entry was made on the record, with the first two years in an appropriate office of the Firm. (Organizational documents are retained for the life of the Firm plus three years after termination.)","source_document":"02_compliance_manual.md","section":"SECTION 13. RECORDKEEPING > 13.2 Retention Period","quote":"The Firm retains all required books and records for not less than seven years from the end of the fiscal year during which the last entry was made on the record, the first two years in an appropriate office of the Firm. This period exceeds the five-year period required by Rule 204-2. Organizational documents are retained for the life of the Firm and for three years after its termination."}
